name: Habibur Unused Image Cleaner
author: Habibur Rahman

sections.description:
Habibur Unused Image Cleaner is a fast, safe, and deep-scanning tool designed to find and clean up images in your Media Library that are not used anywhere on your website.

Unlike simple database queries, our deep-scanning engine checks your site comprehensively, including:
* Gutenberg & Classic Editor content
* Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, Zion, Breakdance
* Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) & custom fields
* WooCommerce products, galleries, and categories
* Widgets, Menus, User Meta, and Theme Mods
* Revolution Slider

Features

  • Deep Scan: Checks 20+ content sources to ensure no false positives.
  • Safe Clean: Moves deleted images to the WordPress Trash, allowing easy recovery.
  • Whitelist Protection: Exclude specific images from being deleted.
  • Real-time Stats: Instantly view reclaimable space, scan date, and total unused files.
  • Modern Interface: Sleek, responsive, and animated dark/light user dashboard built on modern CSS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the habibur-unused-image-cleaner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Image Cleaner’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click ‘Scan Now’ and review your unused images.
sections.faq:
Is it safe to delete images?

Yes. The plugin moves deleted images to the WordPress Trash instead of deleting them permanently from the server disk. You can recover any image from the Media Library trash if you change your mind.

Does it support page builders?

Yes, it has deep scan support for Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, Zion, Breakdance, and more.
